standard_prerequisites.name: Higher direct images commute with filtered colimits
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that the higher direct images of a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism commute with filtered colimits of sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the commutation used to write both sides of the base change map as filtered colimits over the truncations F[n] of the coefficient sheaf, reducing to the case of a sheaf annihilated by an integer.

standard_prerequisites.name: Leray's acyclicity lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Derived Categories, the lemma that a bounded below complex of acyclic objects computes the derived functor
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the conclusion that f'_*(g')^{-1}I^bullet computes Rf'_*(g')^{-1}F for an injective resolution I^bullet of a sheaf annihilated by a prime.

standard_prerequisites.name: Base change tested on pushforwards of injective sheaves
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma that base change for a sheaf annihilated by a prime follows from the vanishing of the higher direct images of the pullback of an injective sheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the final step identifying the map on the level of complexes with the base change map, completing the equivalence.

core_obligations: Give the trivial direction (proof lines 18373-18374): property (1) immediately gives (2), since base change applied to the injective sheaf I says that R^q f'_*(g')^{-1}I equals the pullback of R^q f_*I, which vanishes for q > 0 as I is injective.

Reduce to sheaves killed by an integer (proof lines 18375-18396): for a torsion abelian sheaf F write F = colim F[n] over the subsheaves annihilated by n; the pullbacks commute with colimits as left adjoints and the higher direct images along f and f' commute with filtered colimits by the cited lemma, so both sides of the base change map are the corresponding colimits and it suffices to treat F annihilated by a positive integer n.

Reduce to sheaves killed by a prime (proof lines 18398-18410): for n = l n' the short exact sequence 0 -> F[l] -> F -> F/F[l] -> 0 with F/F[l] annihilated by n' lets the long exact sequence of higher direct images and the five lemma propagate the base change property, so one reduces to F annihilated by a prime number l.

Finish with injective resolutions (proof lines 18412-18427): choose an injective resolution F -> I^bullet in D(X_etale, Z/lZ); assumption (2) and Leray's acyclicity lemma show that f'_*(g')^{-1}I^bullet computes Rf'_*(g')^{-1}F, and the cited base change lemma for the pushforward of an injective sheaf gives the required isomorphism g^{-1}R^q f_*F -> R^q f'_*(g')^{-1}F.
proof_roadmap: Note one direction is immediate from evaluating the base change map on an injective sheaf.
Write the coefficient sheaf as a filtered colimit of its torsion truncations and use commutation with filtered colimits.
Split off the l-torsion part to reach sheaves annihilated by a prime.
Replace such a sheaf by an injective resolution, apply Leray acyclicity, and invoke the base change lemma for the pushforward of an injective sheaf.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a proper morphism f : X -> Y of schemes two conditions are equivalent: cohomology commutes with base change for f, and for every prime l, every injective sheaf I of Z/lZ-modules on X_etale and every base change diagram the sheaves R^q f'_*(g')^{-1}I vanish for q > 0 (statement lines 18359-18371). The proof (proof lines 18373-18428) gives one direction directly and reduces the converse in three steps: filtered colimits over torsion truncations, splitting off l-torsion via the long exact sequence, and an injective resolution combined with Leray's acyclicity lemma. H2: a three-step reduction with three independent inputs, all written out.
